name: Swallow Electro
source:
The vice director of the Amaterasu Corporation Peacekeepers.

She is Yomi's right hand and takes pride in the trust and affection he has for her. She has a coercive way with words and actions and has no mercy for those who defy her, becoming obedient only when Yomi is involved.
